messages:
marta: Quick preflight for tomorrow's minor release bump — planning to cut at 09:00 PT. Targets: API v0.15.2, runtime v1.3.0, console v0.8.7, sdk-js v0.15.2. Any blocking changelog items, migration notes, or release blockers?

sam: API PR is open (#4212) — needs one more approval. Small doc fix left. Should be green by EOD.

lauren: I can handle SDK changelog and add a short migration note about the header rename. Will push a PR with the changelog entry in a minute.

devon: Runtime has a kernel selector edge-case — pretty small but needs a unit test. Can land as a hotfix post-cutoff only if it passes local e2e smoke (~20m). Otherwise will go in next patch release.

marta: Cutoff policy reminder: no breaking changes after 09:00 PT unless security or infra critical. Small bugfixes that complete within 30m of testing OK with release owner signoff.

sam: Can we do a canary on dedicated-2a for the runtime change before the general tag? Want to validate latency distribution.

marta: Yes — plan: canary to dedicated-2a at +10m after tag, monitor 15m. If tail latency spike <5% we promote. Otherwise rollback.

releases-bot: INF-289: Release ticket created and linked. Checklist: bump versions, update changelogs, run release CI, publish SDKs, create release notes draft. (link: https://go/release/INF-289)

lauren: SDK publish plan: will publish `sdk-js@0.15.2-beta` once package bump is merged, run smoke, then promote to `latest`. I’ll post the npm dist-tag steps in the PR.

adeline: Console has one UX doc tweak outstanding — small copy change in changelog UI. Will have PR up in 30m. Also tagging the console release notes with screenshots.

marta: Action items summary that I’ll track:
- sam: finish API PR and push approval (ETA EOD)
- lauren: changelog + SDK publish steps (ETA 1h)
- devon: runtime unit test + canary plan (ETA before cutoff)
- adeline: console doc tweak + screenshots (ETA 30m)

Please add any missed items. I’ll cut the tags at 09:00 PT and run the `release/cut` job.

qa-bot: Release CI matrix queued: smoke (linux/mac), integration (runtime hooks), canary monitor rule attached. Report will be in ~12m.

sam: One more ask — remind QA to watch embedding regression tests; small change in API client could affect batch behavior.

lauren: noted. I’ll include the client-side batch behavior note in the changelog entry.

devon: If canary looks flaky I’ll open a rollback PR immediately and ping here.

marta: Perfect. If everyone is clear, I’ll create the git tags and kick the cut job at 09:00 PT. Post-cut, please wait for the release CI green before promoting SDK -> latest.

sam: :thumbsup:

lauren: :raised_hands: will watch publish logs

adeline: :ok_hand: screenshots staged

releases-bot: Reminder will post at 08:30 PT for final signoffs.

marta: Thanks all — will update here if anything changes.
